description: Self-hosted Renovate runner config for this automation repo. Dependency update policy stays in each repository's renovate.json and the shared default.json preset.
Use a self-hosted branch prefix so this runner cannot overwrite or fight hosted Mend Renovate branches during migration.

branchPrefixOld must equal branchPrefix: Renovate's default branchPrefixOld is renovate/, which makes this runner try to adopt hosted Mend's branches as its own pre-rename branches — they show as 'PR Edited (Blocked)' and stall the self-hosted PR (field-hit on the first proof run against roost's renovate/non-major-dependencies). Equal values disable adoption entirely.
